name: Kuga Shiou
source:
For some reason, the scion of the "Kuga clan" wants to kill Kaoru. As a result of being educated from an early age to extinguish "Serahime's Soul", while possessing excellent powers, he has become distorted.

A hedonist who loves fighting. He always looks bossy and thinks that Kaoru is a "good toy."

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
